items.review_rationale: Read convergence of infinite real series through limits of finite partial sums, with nonnegative integer index and specified real limit s; distinguished sequence of coefficients from its sequence of sums.

references.context: Function indexed by natural numbers with real values.
Real sum of terms a_0 through a_N for a fixed nonnegative index N.

references.phrase: limit of partial sums as N to infinity
references.context: For every real epsilon>0 all sufficiently late partial sums lie within epsilon of s.
The numerical value assigned to an infinite series only when partial sums converge.

items.review_rationale: Read right coset Hg of subgroup H as products hg with h varying and g fixed, keeping right-sided order distinct from left coset in nonabelian groups.

references.context: Map h↦hg of subgroup elements using multiplication by g on the right.
Image set {hg:h in H} for fixed g in G.

references.phrase: right coset not necessarily left coset
references.disposition: Without normality of H, Hg need not equal gH.

items.review_rationale: Read subgroup as subset H of group G carrying inherited binary operation that itself obeys all group axioms; arbitrary subsets are not assumed closed.

references.context: Use same multiplication * as G, with H closed so each pair in H yields element in H.
Closure, associativity, identity and inverses hold for restriction of ambient operation.

references.disposition: No new independently chosen group law is allowed on H in this subgroup formulation.

items.review_rationale: Read measurable space as pair of set X and sigma-algebra Sigma over all its measurable subsets, with no assigned numerical measure.

references.context: Members of Sigma; not automatically every subset in the full power set.

references.disposition: A measure or probability function is not part of this definition.
